title: Skyline Penthouse 6BR/4,400 sq ft Walk to Broadway
description:
Walk to Broadway from this 4,400 sq ft Penthouse with  2 floors and 7 sleeping areas at The Maddox Hotel. Includes a 1500 sq ft outdoor patio deck overlooking the city.  It  is ideal for bachelor/bachelorette gatherings, special occasions, corporate retreats, executive getaway or business meeting. Every member of your group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located suite. TPAC, Bridgestone Arena, Titans Stadium, The Gulch, and 2nd & Broadway are all within walking distance

The space
Our beautifully furnished 4,400 sq feet unit has 6 bedrooms, an additional sleeping area and 4 full baths (1 of the bathrooms is in the Penthouse). This suite has the most unique Penthouse downtown and a 1,500 sq ft of rooftop deck for your exclusive enjoyment. It's ideal for parties, corporate or business meetings and more. The space includes high-speed WiFi, AV equipment, breakout areas and catering options. You also have a full kitchen, refrigerator and freezer, ice maker, dishwasher, air fryer, crock pot, waffle maker, and toasters.

Other things to note
The Maddox Hotel Team is available 24/7 via your booking app. We can interact as much or as little as you would like. This is your party!! There is a downtown grocery store within walking distance or a Whole Foods and Publix, both a mile away. If you are holding a business meeting or corporate retreat, we can provide white boards as well as game rooms in each suite for team building.
